src: Marketing Drive: 2026 Campaigns, Campaign Management, MARKETING folder briefs, Official Calendar, Partnerships sheet, Slerp Marketing Plan, Deliveroo x JTBD tracker
note: One entry per promotion. sites = site codes or ALL; [] = not site specific (not shown on site pages). A site page shows an entry only while it is in play (start on or before today, end on or after today). Edit this file when the marketing team changes a promo.

items.title: Slerp 50% Off First Order (Wave 1 Launch)
items.channel: Slerp (Maki Delivery app, Order to Home)
items.offer: 50% off first order over £20 on Slerp, excluding drinks and frozen ramen; any customer with an account; one use per account
details: Calendar cell: "Slerp 50% Off First Order Promo - Wave 1 Launch 16/10 Aberdeen, Nottingham, Shoreditch".
Marketing Plan (updated 15/10): Wave 1 "Fri 16 to Sun 14 Oct" [sic, Fri 16 to Sun 18 Oct]: M13 Aberdeen, M19 Shoreditch; North/Midlands N/A. Nottingham now listed in Wave 3.
B2B report 9-16 Oct: "Nottingham delay - 15 October: 68 launch-delay messages were reported sent... a revised launch confirmation would follow". Status: "Delay communicated; revised date pending".
Materials arrival: Aberdeen, Shoreditch by 14 October. Dark ads and CRM go live 16 October.
B2B tracker: wave 1 launch window 16-18 Oct; main email deadline 14 Oct; awareness deadline 11 Oct; owner Kei.
Initial push Fri 16 to Sun 18 Oct, review Monday; offer stays live to 29/11.
EC sign-off for wave 1 kitchens: Matt Polak (Aberdeen), Rémy Eutrope (Shoreditch), Srawut "O" Chairipu (Nottingham).
Offer (Marketing Plan): "50% Off First order over £20 on Slerp - excluding drinks and frozen ramen". Who: "Any customer with account". When: "Valid from Wave 1 (16th October) until November 29th".
How: "Discount will be automatically applied when ordering for the first time". Slerp Orders SoT shows the discount code 50FIRST in use (76 orders, £1,777.54 discount as of 20/10).
Where: "All Maki & Ramen branches - excluding Franchise sites, SJQ & Leith Street". Excluded: ALL Franchises (Byres Road, Northern Quarter, The O2, Braehead), St James Quarter (M7) and Leith Street.
Promo is "fully live from the date it rolls out in your branch until the end of promotion on Sunday November 29th"; wave dates mark when the site's initial marketing push activates.
Key dates: Initial roll out 16 Oct; Final roll out 13 Nov; UK wide marketing launch 16 Nov; End date 29 Nov.

Strategy PDF rules: limit 1 use per customer account; no discount cap, no daily redemption cap; minimum order £20 before discount (customer always pays at least £10); delivery fee standard, not discounted; Slerp matches in-store prices (below Deliveroo).

Redeemable ONLY via the Slerp weblink in the Maki Delivery app ("Order to Home"): not in-store, not on Deliveroo, not by phone. Staff script: send customers to download Maki Delivery and tap Order to Home.
Customer message: "50% off your first order. Download Maki Delivery, tap Order to Home. Min spend £20."
Loyalty: Trifft/loyalty points do NOT currently accrue on Slerp orders (integration underway); do not promise points.

On-site materials (all participating branches, ordered automatically by Georgie, arrive the week the site goes live): A5 table toppers; vouchers for Deliveroo order bags (remarketing to Slerp); £5 Slerp voucher for Slerp orders (repeat custom); Loyalty voucher cards.

GM actions: A5 table toppers on ALL tables; brief team to put Deliveroo remarketing vouchers ONLY in Deliveroo bags and £5 repeat vouchers ONLY in Slerp bags; snooze out-of-stock items on Deliverect and POS so Slerp orders do not fail.

Targets: 150 Slerp orders/week and £4,000/week by w/c 16 Nov; AOV £32+; 300 orders/week by Dec; 500/week by Q1 2027; refund rate under 2%; per wave site 20 orders and 15 new customers per Fri-Sun wave; time to accept under 2 min; 0 orders left on Accepted.
Full UK marketing push: socials launch 16/11; CRM staggered reminder 16/11 (waves 1-3) and 20/11 (waves 4-5); socials reminder 23/11; big final push socials + CRM 27/11.

Owners: Georgie Riddle (project lead, marketing); Michael Salvador (sponsor); Becca Cuthbertson (brand/copy approval); Ross Ward (Slerp backend, order monitoring, first-line support); Inka Cheung (Slerp menu, promo set-up, test orders, can pause promo at one site); Kei Cannon (B2B outreach per wave); Lincoln/Ziang Lin (site ops support, staff briefing).
Budget (proposal): print about £60 per site (about £1,300), contingency £500; discount cost about £17 per promo order at £34.69 AOV (every 100 promo orders about £1,700 discount).
Slerp support contact: technical.support@slerp.com.
Calendar cell: "Slerp 50% Off First Order Promo - Complete Rollout 16/11 - 29/11 ALL SITES".
Marketing Plan Wave 6: Mon 16th - Sun 29th Nov: "ALL PARTICIPATING SITES NOW ACTIVE WITH FULL MARKETING PUSH".
Launch on socials (IG, TikTok & LinkedIn) 16/11/2026; CRM staggered push 16/11 (waves 1-3) and 20/11 (waves 4-5); socials reminder 23/11; big final push socials + CRM 27/11.
Strategy PDF: results review w/c Mon 16 Nov with Finance and Slerp; decide always-on offer.
